failure_mode: Pair-level resources may not form target-wise screening pools.
evidence: SMRTnet's fold-preserving official ligand-based CV split has zero target-wise pools at the 20- and 50-candidate thresholds under this protocol; DeepRNA-DTI is a partial portability/resource-suitability case study using the processed unseen_compound prediction table.
protocol_use: Motivates explicit resource-suitability checks before treating pair-level resources as target-wise screening benchmarks.

failure_mode: Target-wise ranking can be saturated by ligand-only priors.
evidence: In ROBIN molecule perturbation, RNAsmol and strong ligand-only baselines all place the first hit at rank 1 for nearly all >=50 pools.
protocol_use: Prevents overclaiming early-hit gains and clarifies why molecule perturbation is a saturation diagnostic.

failure_mode: Chemical similarity does not guarantee label transfer under target/network perturbation.
evidence: Network perturbation has near-identical chemistry to training compounds but much weaker nearest-neighbor label agreement; RNAsmol gains more in low-agreement pools.
protocol_use: Supports target-context stress testing within a low-cost screening protocol without claiming a causal RNA-binding mechanism.
